system.boundary: Build a physically causal five-piston axial-piston pump test rig in Simscape Fluids.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal five-piston axial-piston pump test rig in Simscape Fluids.
A driven cylinder block, five evenly phased physical pistons, valve-plate inlet and discharge paths, and a physically actuated swash plate must form the pumping mechanism.

Include a physical load-sensing control unit that adjusts the swash-plate yoke to maintain useful delivery flow as load changes, together with pressure-limiting control that reduces displacement and prevents pump outlet pressure from materially exceeding 27 MPa.
physical_paths: Feed the pump from a finite-pressure booster supply and discharge it through a variable load orifice.

The same closed physical control path must respond to each load transition and move the yoke; a prescribed flow trace, copied pressure signal, or mechanically disconnected hydraulic control is not valid.
piston_kinematics has 10 channels in this order: piston 1 through 5 displacement (m), followed by piston 1 through 5 velocity (m/s).
